question: When we look around our home, where can we easily find beautiful repeating patterns? 🛏️
explanation: Super! If you look closely, things like bedsheets, curtains, and tiles have wonderful repeating patterns on them! 🛏️
hint: It is made of cloth and you sleep on it.

question: What beautiful, colorful art do we make on the floor during festivals? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Rangoli is a beautiful floor pattern made with colored powder or flowers! 🌼
hint: We make it near the door on Diwali.

question: Which animal has a natural pattern of black and white stripes? 🦓
explanation: Great job! Nature gives zebras a beautiful pattern of bold black and white stripes! 🦓
hint: It looks a bit like a striped horse.

question: What is the red repeating pattern you see when you look at a house wall? 🧱
explanation: Fantastic! Bricks are arranged in a neat, repeating pattern to build strong walls! 🧱
hint: It is made of red, rectangular blocks.

question: What pattern do we often see outside our house windows for safety? 🪟
explanation: Wonderful! Iron grills have shapes like squares or flowers that repeat to make a nice pattern! 🪟
hint: It is made of hard metal.

question: What common local craft is made by weaving dry grass or bamboo together? 🧺
explanation: Super! People weave thin pieces of bamboo or grass in a beautiful pattern to make baskets! 🧺
hint: You can keep fruits in it.

question: What everyday craft item is shaped by spinning soft mud on a wheel? 🏺
explanation: Awesome! The potter shapes wet clay into beautiful pots and adds lovely patterns to them! 🏺
hint: We store cool water in it.

question: Where can you find a long, repeating pattern of threads on your mother's dress? 🥻
explanation: Great job! The edges of a saree often have wonderful repeating designs called borders! 🌸
hint: It is the decorative edge of a long Indian dress.

question: Which flying insect has colorful, matching patterns on its wings? 🦋
explanation: Fantastic! If you look closely, a butterfly's left wing has the exact same beautiful pattern as its right wing! 🦋
hint: It is very colorful and loves flowers.

question: If you close your eyes and touch a big tree, how does its bark feel? 🌳
explanation: Super! The outside part of a tree, called the bark, has a rough texture and deep lines! 🌳
hint: It feels hard and scratchy.

question: How does a fluffy teddy bear or a wool blanket feel when you touch it? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! Things made of cotton, fur, or wool have a very soft and lovely texture! 🧶
hint: It feels like hugging a cloud.

question: What pattern do your shoes leave behind when you walk on wet mud? 🥾
explanation: Wonderful! The bottom of your shoe has a pattern that stamps onto soft mud or sand! 👣
hint: They are the marks made by your feet.

question: If you hold a green leaf up to the light, what lovely pattern can you see inside it? 🍃
explanation: Great job! Leaves have tiny lines called veins that make a beautiful net-like pattern! 🌱
hint: They look like thin, branching lines.

question: How do artists stamp lovely flowers and elephants on colorful clothes? 🐘
explanation: Fantastic! Artists use carved wooden blocks dipped in color to print amazing patterns on cloth! 🎨
hint: They press a carved wooden shape on the fabric.

question: What local craft is made by stringing tiny colorful stones or glass together? 📿
explanation: Super! Stringing colorful beads together makes a beautiful pattern that you can wear! ✨
hint: You wear this around your neck.

question: When looking at old buildings, what beautiful art can you see on heavy wooden doors? 🚪
explanation: Awesome! Artists carve lovely flowers and shapes into wood to make doors look grand! 🚪
hint: It is a design cut into the wood.

question: What square pieces cover our bathroom and kitchen floors in a neat pattern? 🛁
explanation: Wonderful! Tiles are laid side by side to make a beautiful, repeating pattern on floors and walls! ⬜
hint: They are smooth, flat, and square.

question: Which beautiful bird has a pattern of shiny 'eyes' on its tail feathers? 🦚
explanation: Great job! A peacock's feathers have amazing colorful spots that look like shiny blue and green eyes! 🦚
hint: It dances in the rain.

question: What fun craft do we make by folding paper to look like a tiny ship? ⛵
explanation: Fantastic! Folding paper (origami) creates neat, straight lines and shapes to make cool toys! 📄
hint: It floats on rainwater puddles.

question: Where can you see a pretty painted pattern when drinking your milk? 🥛
explanation: Super! Everyday objects like cups, plates, and mugs have wonderful designs to make us smile! 🍽️
hint: It has a handle and holds a hot drink.

question: What handmade craft is used to get cool air when it is very hot? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! Hand fans are beautifully woven from palm leaves or bamboo to keep us cool! 🎋
hint: You wave it back and forth.

question: What amazing net pattern is built by a small eight-legged insect? 🕸️
explanation: Wonderful! Spiders weave thin, sticky silk in perfect circles and lines to make a beautiful web! 🕷️
hint: It catches flies and bugs.

question: When you look up at the sky, what fluffy white things make different shapes? ☁️
explanation: Great job! Clouds move and change, making lovely, fluffy shapes in the blue sky! 🌤️
hint: They look like floating cotton.

question: What tiny, beautiful clay craft do we fill with oil and light on Diwali? 🪔
explanation: Fantastic! Clay diyas are lovely little lamps designed by potters to bring light and joy! ✨
hint: It has a cotton wick and burns oil.

question: What do we call the art of making patterns on cloth using a needle and thread? 🪡
explanation: Super! Embroidery is a beautiful local craft where colorful threads create flowers and designs on fabric! 🌸
hint: It is also called stitching art.

question: What beautiful, colorful part of a flower grows in a perfect circle? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! A flower's petals are arranged in a lovely, matching pattern around the center! 🌼
hint: They smell sweet and have pretty colors.

question: How does a river pebble feel when you pick it up and rub it? 🪨
explanation: Wonderful! Rushing river water rubs the stones for many years until they feel perfectly smooth! 💧
hint: It is a small rock from the water.

question: What patterned cloth do we hang on windows to block the sunlight? 🪟
explanation: Great job! Curtains have lovely prints and colors, adding beautiful design to our rooms! ☀️
hint: They slide open and closed.

question: Which wild cat is famous for having beautiful dark spots all over its coat? 🐆
explanation: Fantastic! A leopard's fur has amazing patterns of spots that help it hide in the forest! 🌳
hint: It runs fast and has dots on its fur.

question: What black and white pattern on the road helps us cross safely? 🦓
explanation: Super! Zebra crossings use a simple, repeating stripe design to keep people safe on the road! 🛣️
hint: It looks like a zebra's back.

question: What useful, strong craft is made from weaving golden-brown plant fibers? 🌾
explanation: Awesome! Jute fibers are woven into a rough but beautiful cross-pattern to make strong bags! 🌾
hint: It is also called a gunny bag.

question: What warm clothing craft has loops of yarn pulled through each other? 🧶
explanation: Wonderful! Knitting creates a lovely pattern of tiny loops to make cozy winter clothes! 🧣
hint: Your grandma might make this with two needles.

question: What lovely curved shape can you spot above the doors of old monuments? 🏛️
explanation: Great job! Builders long ago designed beautiful curved arches to make doorways look grand and strong! 🏰
hint: It looks like a half-circle.

question: What amazing pattern of small wax hexagons do bees build? 🐝
explanation: Fantastic! Bees are wonderful builders who make a perfect repeating pattern to store sweet honey! 🐝
hint: It is full of sweet, sticky liquid.

question: If you look at a cactus plant, what do you see patterned all over it? 🌵
explanation: Super! Nature covers the cactus with a pattern of sharp thorns to protect it in the desert! 🌵
hint: They are very prickly and sharp.

question: When the sun shines on a window grill, what dark pattern appears on the floor? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Light creates lovely shadow patterns of objects when it shines right through them! ☀️
hint: It is the dark shape on the ground.

question: What patterned cloth do we spread on the floor to make the room look nice? 🛋️
explanation: Wonderful! Carpets and rugs have beautiful woven designs that make our homes look amazing! 🏠
hint: You step on it inside the house.

question: What lovely patterned objects can you pick up while walking on the beach? 🏖️
explanation: Great job! Seashells have amazing spirals, lines, and colors created by nature in the ocean! 🌊
hint: They are hard and you find them near the sea.

question: What colorful glass craft makes a jingling sound on women's wrists? ✨
explanation: Fantastic! Glassmakers craft these beautiful round bangles with amazing colors and shiny patterns! ✨
hint: They are round and worn on the arms.

question: What clever design connects the center of a bicycle wheel to its edge? 🚲
explanation: Super! The thin metal spokes form a neat sun-ray pattern to make the wheel very strong! 🚴
hint: They look like thin, shiny wires.

question: When a tree trunk is cut, what round pattern can you see inside it? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! The rings tell us the age of the tree, creating a lovely circular pattern inside the wood! 🌳
hint: They look like many circles inside each other.

question: What pattern do we make when we neatly stack clean plates in the kitchen? 🍽️
explanation: Wonderful! Placing things one on top of the other creates a neat, everyday design in our homes! 🍽️
hint: Putting them one over the other.

question: What local craft is rolled out on the floor for people to sit and eat together? 🍱
explanation: Great job! Mats (chatais) are beautifully woven with plastic or bamboo strips in a criss-cross pattern! 🧺
hint: It is also called a chatai.

question: What big, beautiful arch of seven colors appears in the sky after rain? 🌈
explanation: Fantastic! Nature paints a lovely arch pattern using seven beautiful colors when sunlight hits raindrops! 🌦️
hint: It has red, yellow, blue, and more colors.

question: What repeating clay pieces are arranged on village roofs to slide rain off? 🏠
explanation: Super! Red clay tiles overlap each other in a beautiful pattern to protect houses from the rain! 🌧️
hint: They are placed on top of the house.

question: What woody, patterned object falls from a pine tree in the mountains? 🌲
explanation: Awesome! A pinecone has a beautiful, overlapping spiral pattern of tough wooden scales! ⛰️
hint: It looks like a small wooden egg.

question: What traditional wooden toy is dressed in colorful clothes and dances on strings? 🎭
explanation: Wonderful! String puppets (Kathputlis) are an amazing local craft full of colorful designs and bright clothes! 🎨
hint: Someone pulls its strings to make it dance.

question: What everyday object has a circular pattern of numbers from 1 to 12? 🕰️
explanation: Great job! A clock uses a perfect circular design with numbers evenly spaced so we can tell the time! ⏰
hint: It goes tick-tock.

question: What lovely circles appear when you gently drop a stone into a quiet pond? 💧
explanation: Fantastic! The water pushes out in perfect, growing circles to make a beautiful, moving pattern! 💧
hint: They are small waves moving outward.

question: What tool can you use to look closely at tiny patterns on a tiny bug? 🔍
explanation: Super! A magnifying glass makes everything look bigger so we can see all the amazing hidden designs in the world! 🌍
hint: It is a round glass with a handle.
